engine.structure: TEST FIXTURE toy generator (normal team scores → random quarter split → OT until untied → random coherent allocation); NOT the nba-sim-v1 engine

representativeSamples.label: typical
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose (margin, total) is nearest the medians (standardised distance; lowest index on ties)

representativeSamples.label: close
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw with the smallest |regulation margin| (an overtime draw counts as 0), then total nearest the median

representativeSamples.label: upset
representativeSamples.selectionRule: among draws the pre-game underdog wins, the one nearest |median margin| and the median total
